methodology.summary: The Patch benchmark values are aligned directly to the live Adopt Me Values feed so our benchmark pets match the same public lanes shown at adoptmevalues.app/values.
notes: Benchmark pets mirror the live Adopt Me Values public feed as of 2026-07-17.
No Potion, Fly, Ride, Fly Ride, Neon, and Mega lanes are carried through from the same tracker source.
Values can still move quickly, so recheck the source feed before making high-stakes trades.
